name: Math
description: A manim-style math explainer look: coloured math on a near-black stage, with serif type written on, axes and graphs swept-drawn, equations transforming into each other and a tracking dot with a live decimal readout. Clean vector strokes where the colour coding does the work.

Ideas with a picture, like a geometric fact
Rigorous explainers where the math on screen must be true
style: cth-animate — manim-style, coloured math on near-black, written serif type, swept graphs
